fieldValues.title: Cut the undeclarable rules from the normative surface
fieldValues.summary: Applies the level test to the 127 invariant + 161 mechanism records scripts/spec-language-registry.json declares normative (~19 rules, disposition table A-D: relation-shape rules, semantic-judgement invariants, conventions dressed as mechanisms, governance/doctrine mechanisms). Retires in place (record_transition/record_update, never file deletion or renumbering) and relocates to #819's language-guide section or the charter. Re-cuts mechanism-aa154cf4's conformance enumeration in the same PR or the core profile stays unsatisfiable.
fieldValues.body:
Wave 2 unit (meaning-placement sweep). Blocked on #812 — that ruling licenses these cuts. Method: retire in place, never delete files or renumber invariants (I-number uniqueness is a live check, cited externally). All writes through the srs-spec MCP server or the CLI, never raw file edits.

Held by owner ruling — not cut, carried to #820 instead: mechanism-b3c293f9 (naming grammar) and mechanism-d453219f (.srs/README.md, amended to state its technical reason).

Mode complex, Door 2/3 (removes normative meaning; amends accepted RFC surface) — gate:owner-merge. Not yet scheduled.
